name: 2015-2017 Dodge Challenger SRT / Hellcat V8-6.2L aFe POWER Magnum FORCE Cold Air Intake System Rain Shield w/ Carbon Fiber Finish
description: For those of you who have an aFe Power Stage-2 intake system for the 2015-2016 Dodge Challenger SRT Hellcat V8-6.2L (sc), aFe Power now offers a performance air filter rain shield cover to protect the air filter from water falling through the factory hood scoops. This cover is constructed of vacuum formed ABS plastic material with carbon fiber finish that clamps right up to the filter flange. This cover provides a stealthy yet aggressive style without hurting the performance of the intake.Features:Fits: Dodge Challenger SRT Hellcat V8-6.2L 2015-2017Made in USAAggressive StyleCarbon Fiber FinishProtects the Air Filter From WaterNote: This rain shield only fits with aFe's Stage-2 Intake System.
